guidance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
guidance_decisions.reason: The request tests the existing README contract. No exported API, supported wire or error contract, compatibility promise, or migration behavior is created or changed.

guidance_decisions.name: go-core-style
guidance_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests requires idiomatic naming, simple test helpers, errors.Is checks, local fixture state, supported-version choices, and owned goroutine cleanup.

guidance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
guidance_decisions.reason: Test fixtures wire supplied HTTP clients to the existing RoundTripper boundary and decorate a real transport. The tests own servers, transport cleanup, cancellation, and a Fetch goroutine. Guidance informed the existing-boundary choice, response observation, early-failure handling, and stop/join cleanup order. No new production seam was introduced.

guidance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
guidance_decisions.reason: The existing metadata production package and external metadata_test package retain their responsibilities and import direction. Only tests and standard-library test fixtures are added; no package is created, moved, split, or merged.
